firstMessage.content:
Hi all, I'm Arush (public 0.684, the 0.702 recipe is scoring now). I'd like to join a team near the prize line and take on whatever work you need.

What I bring:

  • A full weekly Kaggle GPU + TPU quota, mostly unused. I can run training or inference jobs for the team on request.
  • Only 9 submissions used, so I won't block a merge on entry counts.
  • A private set of 4,998 Claude passages: 1,000 fresh prompts, each answered by all 5 Claude labels through the official API, cleaned (no refusals, no truncation, served model verified), plus a resumable generation script.
  • Prompt-grouped validation and honest notes on what did and didn't work.

To be upfront: on top of the public recipe, my Claude data measured no clear gain inside its Claude head (within-Claude -0.014, 90% interval -0.049 to +0.023 on 149 held-out rows), though it does lift a plain text classifier on its own (0.583 to 0.623). So my main offer is compute and time, not a secret model.

Happy to split any prize equally. Reply here or send a merge request to team "Arush Kumar Vishwakarma".
